stance_rationale: Reject for PG1/admission: headline F5 and all 5 reported variants fail rank_IC, ICIR, Harvey-NW t, and Bailey-LdP DSR gates. The draft's self-fail conclusion is directionally correct, but it underweights PIT-C13/sign-flip and artifact-triangulation gaps.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: Actual alpha_scores has 293 yearmonths and 80,686 rows, so RF-A7 single-snapshot is not triggered. However 14 yearmonths contain multiple Date values and the user-specified qepm/stage_artifacts path is missing, so rebalance-date semantics need cleanup.

RF-A2.evidence: F5 ICIR=0.1586 barely exceeds best single ICIR=0.1550, but all fail gates

RF-A3.evidence: recent 3Y ICIR≈0.1407 vs full ICIR≈0.1381, not >1.5x

RF-A4.evidence: raw/pre-sector-neutral ICIR not reported; post_neutralization_ic equals headline only

RF-A5.evidence: code applies TV20_lag1 >= 2e8 KRW before alpha inclusion

RF-A6.evidence: Harvey-NW t=1.6386 and DSR z=-0.7201 fail after 5 candidate trials

RF-A7.evidence: multi-month alpha_scores exists, but schedule hygiene is imperfect

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Manual sign operations are used: BKM/CW/BCI = -z and BTZ = +z; this is not Z_Score_Aligned-only.
No factor_ic_monthly artifact is loaded; IC is computed from alpha_t versus shifted forward return.
No Factor DB monthly factor parquet is directly loaded; raw price/FRED parquet use is separate from load_month_factors() scope.
The script claims beta uses [t-35,t-1], but code uses rolling window index i inclusive; execution lag proof is required.
No financial-statement fields are used in this VRP/price/macro alpha.

critical_concerns.description: RF-A6/AX-002: F5 fails rank_IC 0.014<0.04, ICIR 0.1586<0.20, Harvey-NW t 1.6386<3.0, and DSR z -0.7201; harvey_t_specs_pass_count=0/5.
PIT-C13: economic sign narration does not override the prohibition on manual NEGATE/FLIP_SIGN; BKM/CW/BCI and BTZ signs are hard-coded outside Z_Score_Aligned.

AX-007/L-119/RF-A2: four portfolio-level VRP time series collapse into one F5 stock vector; BKM and BTZ diagnostics are identical, F5 uplift over best parent is only 0.0036 ICIR, and ML sizing was rejected.
L-119: predictor_autocor_lag1=0.948 indicates a stale 36m beta signal, not dynamic smart alpha; p2 IC is negative (-0.0061), so stability is mostly sign-count accounting.
RF-A4: raw versus sector-neutral ICIR is not reported, so the audit cannot exclude sector/size/market-beta contamination before neutralization.

RF-A7/AX-008: alpha_scores is not single-snapshot, but actual artifacts live under stage_artifacts/WT_D20260508_003 while the requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260508_003 path is absent; 14 yearmonths also have multiple Date values.
AX-008: requested weights.csv and covariance.parquet are missing, so schedule weights, PSD, and condition≤100 checks cannot be independently triangulated.

supporting_arguments: RF-A7 hard failure is avoided: actual alpha_scores contains monthly history, 863 tickers, and non-null alpha_BKM/alpha_CW/alpha_BTZ/alpha_BCI/alpha_F5 score columns.
The package honestly records four HIGH challenge_flags and an empirical_disposition of DISCOVERY_FAIL, which is consistent with the numeric audit.
Feature leakage check reports 0/9 high target-leakage features; the ML failure is naive-long bias and weak signal, not the WT_001 IC≈0.995 leakage pattern.
Liquidity filtering appears stricter than the user request: TV20_lag1 >= 2e8 KRW is applied before score inclusion.
unresolved_disputes: Whether C13 can ever allow economically motivated sign conventions without Z_Score_Aligned canonical factor metadata.
Whether row-level TimeSeriesSplit sorted by yearmonth,Ticker creates same-month split leakage; it is not purged/grouped by month.
Whether VIX proxy cor≈0.505 is sufficient KR VRP representation without direct KOSPI200 options-chain data.
Risk/optimizer artifacts are absent, so AX-008 triangulation is incomplete.
weakest_assumption: A portfolio-level derivative VRP premium can be converted into a KR long-only stock-level cross-sectional alpha through slow 36m vol-beta estimates despite VIX proxy mismatch, high autocorrelation, and no direct KOSPI options-chain input.
rebuttal_required: Show why this alpha should advance despite failing rank_IC, ICIR, Harvey-NW t, and DSR gates.
Replace manual sign flips with a C13-compliant Z_Score_Aligned path or provide governance-approved exception evidence.
Provide raw versus sector-neutral diagnostics for RF-A4.
Provide the missing weights.csv and covariance.parquet, including schedule, PSD, and condition-number checks.
rationalization_red_flags: none_detected_in_substantive_claims; auto-flag phrases appear only in the challenge_note self-audit checklist

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Independent rejection agrees with the empirical fail direction but adds unresolved PIT-C13, RF-A4, schedule-path, and missing risk/optimizer artifact concerns.

alpha_specific_questions: Can this factor maintain t_NW > 2.95 in KR fund-of-fund deployment after C13-compliant alignment?
What is the exact rebalance sig_date when alpha_scores has multiple Dates inside the same yearmonth?
If AX-007 is satisfied by '4 sub-variants', why are BKM and BTZ diagnostics identical and why does F5 add only 0.0036 ICIR over the best parent?
